evenements.description: Batman The Castle Rises is a Batman-themed burlesque cabaret show at Wiggle Room Montreal. The lineup features Mina Minou, Quinzy Chase, Miami Minx, James and the Giant Pastry, Flame Fatale and Esirena. Doors open at 7:00 PM and the show starts at 9:00 PM.

Je Vais Prendre Mon Temps is a Zee Stacks Production built around tension, slow burn, dark femininity, desire, and rage. Produced, curated, and hosted by Twiggy. The billed company includes Mademoiselle George, Delulu Darling, Aizysse Baga, Lia Jasmine, Baby Hector, Twiggy, Velour, @esirenaa, @heshibaa, and @wish.borne. Doors open at 19:00, with curtains at 20:00. Tickets available online at wiggleroom.ca.
